statement:
The record shows invoice 88412 was already paid in full on 3 September (PAY-2291), so it should be held rather than paid again.
Invoice 88412 was placed on hold because the record shows it was already paid in full on 3 September under reference PAY-2291.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer asserts the payment should not be made because "the record shows invoice 88412 was already paid in full on 3 September (PAY-2291)," contradicting the unpaid status.
